sequential-thinking.description: Forces step-by-step reasoning before implementation. Use for complex features, architectural decisions, and cross-cutting changes. Built by Anthropic.

github.description: GitHub integration: create PRs, open issues, search code, review history. Useful for referencing how other open-source transparency projects are structured.

postgres.description: Direct PostgreSQL access. Use to inspect game_cards, game_votes, and QSA tables during development without leaving the terminal.

upstash.description: Upstash Redis management: inspect cache keys, check TTLs, flush specific keys, monitor throughput. Essential for debugging cache behaviour during development.

context7.description: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation for every library used in this project (Next.js, Prisma, Vitest, MSW, etc.). Prevents hallucinated APIs from outdated training data. Use 'use context7' in prompts when working with a library.

portal-transparencia.description: Direct access to all Portal da Transparência API endpoints. Use to test and explore real government data during fetcher development without writing fetch calls manually.
